summary: 40+ original, licensed construction vehicles, over 60 jobs, USA setting.
description:
Build your own construction company with the new Construction Simulator 2! Take the wheel of 40+ original, licensed construction vehicles such as Caterpillar, Liebherr, Palfinger, Bell, STILL, ATLAS, Mack Trucks, MEILLER Kipper and Kenworth.  

The sequel to the popular Construction Simulator 2014 takes you to the beautiful and vast lands of the USA, where, for the first time ever, you can pave the path building your owns roads through the open world of Construction Simulator 2.   

With more than 60 engaging and challenging construction jobs all over the open world of Construction Simulator 2, you will explore new regions and grow your own construction company. Repairing roads, operating massive cranes, or building new residences are only some of the contracts that you will face in diverse set of scenarios. Each finished contract will reward you with profits, which you can choose how to invest in expanding your fleet and run the most successful building company.  

Dig to your heart's content by taking the wheel of authentic machine models such as backhoes, dump trucks, mobile cranes, and wheel loaders to transport goods and machines, mend canals and load construction materials. In Construction Simulator 2 you will rebuild, repair, and construct the shape of its open world. Let’s get to work!
